templates.why_chosen: A star, sparse-text exemplar of identical internal geometry across (a)/(b): the same stacked-card graph-index drawing convention and blue/red/gray search-path colour code repeat in both panels so only the storage tier differs.
templates.what_to_learn: When comparing two prior designs, redraw the same graph-index glyph and the same colour code (blue = visited path, red = top-k result, gray = unvisited) in each panel, changing only the storage medium each graph sits on.
